brief:
Israel and Saudi Arabia are mounting a coordinated response to Houthi attacks, according to Ma'an Wire. The two countries have intensified military and intelligence cooperation as the Yemen-based militant group continues strikes across the region, targeting shipping lanes and civilian infrastructure.

The alignment brings together two powers previously at odds over broader Middle East policy. Both nations face threats from Houthi drone and missile operations that have disrupted maritime commerce and posed security challenges in the Red Sea and beyond.
title: Israel and Saudi Arabia coordinate against Houthis
